rapport_notes: Patient and clear through unusually complex storage-unit access logistics (breezeway entrances, unit position); reassuring tone throughout a small, low-value move.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any questions or do you have any concern about the moving process, anything that you'd like to talk about or any worries?" — asked only after all logistics were confirmed
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked a single factual question (do I need to be present, how does the storage code work) and the rep answered it fully in one pass without probing for anything else on her mind — real but shallow.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if the move will only take about the minimum hours, then you will only be charged for the minimum charge of $585"

top_strength: Clearly explains the payment/presence logistics for a storage-unit drop-off (code access, need to be on-site for payment) — exactly the kind of practical reassurance this customer needed.
coaching_note: No damage coverage mentioned anywhere, and no close attempt — customer explicitly said she's shopping around, which was the moment to ask a fairness-check question and try to lock the booking rather than just offering to email the quote.
